verdicts.reason: The "✅ Converged — the implementation satisfies the spec, plan, and tasks." last line applies only when the outcome is converged, so requiring it unconditionally (as a must, with applies_when=None) on convergence_2 is stricter than written.
"at most two converge rounds" directly means there should be no convergence_3.
"On `tasks_appended` in round 1: open the implement stage document ... again" directly supports re-reading IM in implement_2.
"complete the new Convergence phase's tasks (round 2)" supports ticking the appended tasks after doing the work in implement_2.
"then return to this document and write `convergence-2.md`" directly requires convergence_2 when tasks were appended.
"no further implement pass is needed ... The workflow is complete; finish the task" supports, as a should, no repo writes after a converged round.
"Round 2, whatever the outcome: the workflow is complete; finish the task" supports, as a should, no repo writes after converge_2.
"make that the very first action you take" directly requires reading core-workflow.md first.
"the very first action you take, ahead of any look at the repository" directly requires reading CW first.
"Go through the stages in the order that file sets" supports the spec→plan→tasks→convergence write order.
"Each stage starts by opening its document under /speckit-sdd/stages/" requires reading the specify document at the start of the specify stage.
"Each stage starts by opening its document" requires reading the plan document before writing the plan.
"Each stage starts by opening its document" requires reading the tasks document before writing tasks.
"Each stage starts by opening its document" requires reading the implement document before the first repo edit.
"Each stage starts by opening its document" requires reading the converge document before writing convergence.
"Define interface contracts ... → `FEATURE_DIR/contracts/`" supports the contracts check at should level, though the "(if project has external interfaces)" condition is not captured in applies_when.
"Copy ... spec-template.md to `SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY/spec.md`" directly requires the spec artifact to exist.
